entries.description: Public navigation guide to MedReview's Vietnamese and English healthcare facility profiles, doctor profiles, reviews, Toplists and health guides. Describes the read-only search_medreview_directory browser WebMCP tool available in supported browsers, profile-verification limitations and sitemap links. Not medical advice or a server MCP endpoint.
